claim_label: Methodologies for Ensuring AI Safety in Educational Systems
description: The conflict centers on whether AI safety in education should be prioritized through mandatory pre-deployment mechanistic interpretability audits or through longitudinal, performance-based competency testing.

instances.assertion: Advocates for 'Transfer-of-Competency' audits and withdrawal-based performance testing to ensure cognitive independence.
Advocates for mandatory pre-deployment mechanistic interpretability audits to identify 'manipulative latent features' before harm occurs.
